description: Monthly budget from job, parent, and aid income against rent, food, books, transport, and fun spending. Returns total income, total expenses, the balance, and the largest category with its share of expenses. Use when a student builds a monthly budget from income against rent, food, books, transport and fun spending. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive Student Budget calculator.
